jobs.title: Environmental Health Officer
jobs.description:
Recent and soon to be Graduates encouraged to apply!

Grade:
9
Weekly Hours:
35 (flexible working arrangements available)
Salary:
From $89,964 (plus superannuation)

About Orange City Council:

Orange City Council is committed to making a positive contribution to both our region and our local community. With around 850 employees, we take pride in being both for and part of the Orange community. Our aim is to make Orange a better place to live today and tomorrow.

About the Role:

Turn your environmental health expertise into visible community impact. In this varied and rewarding role, you’ll help keep Orange safe, healthy and thriving by delivering trusted regulatory services across food safety, public health and environmental protection. From assessing applications and conducting inspections to resolving complaints and providing practical compliance advice, you’ll shape decisions that protect the community and strengthen environmental health standards across the region.
Click on the link to check out the full Position Description (this link will work on Council’s website)
To be successful in the role, you will have:
Relevant degree qualifications in Environmental and Public Health and/or related qualification
Current driver's licence
Satisfactory Criminal Records Check

What’s on Offer:

Work Life Balance
– Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including compressed work weeks or fortnightly RDOs, plus generous leave provisions
Culture
– Join a supportive, safe, diverse and inclusive workplace where your contribution is valued
Security
– Build your future in a permanent full-time role, working 35 hours per week
Career
– Grow your expertise through excellent learning and development opportunities
Wellbeing
– Access Council’s employee assistance program, Fitness Passport and health and wellbeing programs
Job Satisfaction
– See the impact of your work while contributing to a city and region with community at the heart of everything we do

Ready to make an impact?

Bring your expertise, curiosity and commitment to great community outcomes. Apply by submitting your resume and a brief response explaining why you are a great fit for the role. Recent and soon-to-be graduates are encouraged to apply.

Get your application in by: 18 October 2026

Visit www.orange.nsw.gov.au to learn more about Orange City Council

For any enquiries, reach out to Talisa Griffiths, Environmental Health Coordinator, on 02 6393 8204.
Please note: Where additional candidates are found suitable from this round of recruitment a talent list or pool may be created for filling any similar permanent or temporary roles that may become vacant over the next twelve months.
